The '''Crescent Canyon Mesa''' was a massive ice mesa located at the southeastern edge of the [[Whiterock Wastes]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]. It was named for [[Crescent Canyon]], which separated the mesa from the Wastes and [[Highmount Ridge]] to the west. The mesa was the site of the [[Crescent Canyon Facility]], a [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Corporation]] research facility that was later used by [[Ortolan/Legends|Ortolan]] colonists.
